question: Should OpenClaw adopt this reference-inspired phone shell as the next iOS navigation and visual direction after the unified-chat foundation lands?
rationale: The proposed shell intentionally changes the default iPhone hierarchy, navigation vocabulary, and presentation of existing gateway features; that is a product decision rather than a mechanical correction.

options.title: Sponsor the shell after the parent lands
options.body: Confirm this iPhone direction, then have the branch rebase on the landed unified-chat foundation and provide real runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Request a narrower iteration
options.body: Keep the existing phone hierarchy and extract only the individually approved visual or onboarding improvements into smaller follow-up work.

options.title: Pause the proposal
options.body: Defer the shell until iOS product direction and ownership for the connected phone experience are explicitly set.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the shell after the parent lands
recommendation.body: Confirm this iPhone direction, then have the branch rebase on the landed unified-chat foundation and provide real runtime proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Their open parent branch is the concrete foundation that this proposal extends.
